prompt:
What is the total number of licensed beds in the open hospitals inside FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area in Miami-Dade County, Florida?

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q8_2

output.method: I took the HIFLD Hospitals dataset (hospitals-3, 36 Miami-Dade County hospitals, all STATUS OPEN) and the NFHL Miami-Dade S_FLD_HAZ_AR layer, keeping only polygons with SFHA_TF = 'T' as the Special Flood Hazard Area. A QGIS intersect selected 14 open hospitals inside the SFHA, and summing their BEDS values gives 3,993 (none had missing or sentinel bed counts).
